goal: Add a ledger-drift status reporter (scripts/report-ledger-drift-status.mjs) that turns a check-migration-ledger-drift --json result into an issue-comment-ready status report with per-version PR attribution, plus tests and a verification doc. Detection/reporting only — no production apply.
prohibited_actions: No production apply, no migration, no database write.
No secrets in commits, logs, or PR body.
Do not edit the shared checkout; worktree-only.
Do not close issue #2508 — it stays open until production applies land.
assumptions: Issue #2508 is non-orchestrator (detection/reporting tooling and docs).
Six genuinely-pending migration versions need production applies through the bounded Shared Supabase Migrations workflow — that is the orchestrator's lane, not this session's.
The throughput-disposition catalogue for the new script is required because the truth-audit discovers the word 'missing' in comments and error messages.
stop_conditions: Stop if the change would need to touch a migration, database object, or production workflow.
Stop if the drift check itself needs modification (out of scope — this PR adds reporting on top of it).
